{{Quote|Patrol 118 to central! We have been ambushed by terrorists and are in need of reinforcements!|[[Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Onderon)/Legends|The Patrol's commander]]|<ref name="Front Runners">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref>}}
'''Patrol 118''' was a patrol of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] that were stationed on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] under [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. Patrol 118 was attacked by a group of [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] under [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]], and every unit was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]], including [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Onderon)/Legends|their OOM commander]] after it called for reinforcements. The rebels gained an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]] from this assault, which they used to blow up a [[Onderon power generator/Legends|power station]].
